children: SRX Global completed a secured financing with CERo Therapeutics Holdings built around a Consolidated Senior Secured Promissory Note dated August 27, 2026. The Note consolidates $5.67 million of prior notes and permits up to $6.0 million in new advances, for a total of $11.67 million; an initial $775,665 was funded at signing. The Note accrues interest at 10% annually, matures October 15, 2026, and may be extended by SRX for up to four 30-day periods. To secure the loan, CERo pledged all equity of its subsidiary, while the subsidiary granted a lien on substantially all assets and issued an unconditional guaranty of payment.
